title: Periyar 2018 flood: open-data D-Flow FM model, sensitivity and uncertainty workflow (research code and results)
description: Research code, per-run results and manuscript sources for the article "How far can one gauge mark and one radar image narrow parameter uncertainty in an open-data flood model? Sensitivity analysis of the 2018 Periyar flood". The archive is a snapshot of the GitHub fork karthice1/HYDROLIB-core at tag v1.0-periyar, plus the clean-environment test report of that exact commit. Licensing (see NOTICE): HYDROLIB-core 1.5.0, copyright Deltares, MIT (LICENSE), included unchanged; the research code in research/gsa and research/periyar, copyright Karthik V and Roopa D, MIT (research/LICENSE); the manuscript source in research/periyar/manuscript is not MIT-licensed. python -m research.periyar.check_results recomputes 120 published values from the stored results without running D-Flow FM. See README_FIRST.md and research/periyar/REPRODUCE.md.
